entries.question: Opd timings
entries.answer:
The OPD timings at KGMU are as follows:

*   **Monday – Friday:** 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
*   **Saturday:** 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM
*   **Sunday:** Closed

**Important Information:**
*   **Registration:** Online registration is mandatory. You can book appointments via [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in).
*   **Alternative Booking:** You can also call **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**, or send an SMS with "APPOINTMENT <NAME>" to **8887019134**.
*   **Fee:** There is a flat fee of ₹50 for the OPD slip.
*   **Note:** The Parchi (ticket) counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp, so it is highly recommended to arrive early. 

If you have specific medical symptoms or need a diagnosis, please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal health details, Aadhaar numbers, or phone numbers in this chat for your safety.

entries.question: How to appointment
entries.answer:
You can book an OPD appointment at KGMU using any of the following methods:

**1. Online Portal (Recommended)**
*   Visit: [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   **Steps:** Select Uttar Pradesh as the state → Select KGMU as the hospital → Click 'New Appointment' → Choose your department, date, and time slot → Enter patient details → Pay the ₹50 fee online → Download your appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care** app from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register with your mobile number and follow the same steps as the ORS portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the following format: **"APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>"** to **8887019134**.
*   You will receive a booking confirmation.

**4. Walk-in (On-Site)**
*   You can visit the registration counters at the hospital. 
*   **Requirements:** You must bring the patient's **Aadhaar Card** and an active mobile number to receive an OTP.
*   **Note:** The registration counter fee is ₹50.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM | Saturday: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM.
*   **Parchi (Ticket) Counter:** Closes at 1:00 PM sharp. It is strongly recommended to pre-book to avoid long wait times.
*   **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please ensure you bring a valid referral letter for your specific department.

*I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at 0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333. Also, please avoid sharing personal health details, Aadhaar numbers, or phone numbers in this chat for your safety.*

*   **Aadhaar Card:** Walk-in ke liye apna Aadhaar card aur mobile number zaroor sath rakhein.

Main ek AI assistant hoon aur medical advice nahi de sakta. Agar aapko koi gambhir samasya hai, toh kripya turant KGMU OPD mein sampark karein.

entries.question: Kgmu me bsc radiology ki admission process
entries.answer:
KGMU mein B.Sc. Radiology (Medical Radiologic Technology) mein admission ke liye pravesh prakriya (admission process) mukhya roop se entrance exam par aadharit hoti hai.

Yahan kuch mahatvapurn jaankari di gayi hai:

1. **Entrance Exam:** KGMU apne yahan ke paramedical courses (jisme B.Sc. Radiology shamil hai) ke liye pratyek varsh entrance exam conduct karta hai. Aapko is exam mein qualify karna hota hai.
2. **Eligibility (Yogyata):** Aam taur par, candidate ka 10+2 (Intermediate) Physics, Chemistry, aur Biology (PCB) ke saath pass hona zaruri hai.
3. **Application Process:** 
   - Admission ke liye notification KGMU ki official website **[www.kgmu.org](http://www.kgmu.org)** par jari kiya jata hai.
   - Aapko website par jaakar "Admissions" ya "Academic" section check karte rehna hoga, jahan application form aur prospectus uplabdh hota hai.
4. **Counseling:** Entrance exam mein prapt अंकों (marks) ke aadhar par merit list banti hai, jiske baad counseling prakriya hoti hai aur seat allot ki jaati hai.

**Salah:** 
Kyunki admission process har saal badal sakti hai, isliye main sujhaav dunga ki aap samay-samay par **[www.kgmu.org](http://www.kgmu.org)** par 'Admissions' section ko check karte rahein taaki aapko latest prospectus aur dates ki jaankari mil sake. 

Aap KGMU ke Registrar Office se bhi sampark kar sakte hain: **0522-2253171**.

*Note: Main KGMU AI Chatbot hoon, jise Dr. Ayush Yadav dwara banaya gaya hai. Main sirf website par uplabdh jaankari ke aadhar par aapki sahayata kar sakta hoon.*

entries.question: Bsc in physiotherapy ke liye kitne marks chaiye
entries.answer:
KGMU mein **B.Sc. in Physiotherapy** (jise aksar BPT - Bachelor of Physiotherapy kaha jata hai) mein admission prapt karne ke liye koi fix "minimum marks" ka number nahi hota, balki ye **Entrance Examination mein aapki Rank aur Merit** par nirbhar karta hai.

Yahan kuch mukhya baatein hain jo aapko samajhni chahiye:

1.  **Entrance Exam:** KGMU mein admission ke liye aapko university dwara conduct kiya gaya **Common Paramedical Entrance Test (CPET)** ya jo bhi us saal ka nirdharit entrance exam ho, usmein appear hona padta hai.
2.  **Merit-based Selection:** Admission pure taur par entrance exam mein aapke dwara prapt kiye gaye **marks aur rank** ke aadhar par hota hai. Jitne zyada marks honge, utni behtar rank hogi aur admission ke chances utne hi badh jayenge.
3.  **Competition:** Kyunki seats limited hoti hain aur candidates zyada hote hain, isliye aapka lakshya entrance exam mein maximum marks score karna hona chahiye taaki aap "Merit List" mein upar rahein.
4.  **Eligibility:** Aam taur par, candidate ka 10+2 (Intermediate) mein **Physics, Chemistry, aur Biology (PCB)** hona anivarya hai, aur minimum 50% marks (general category ke liye) hona zaruri hota hai (ye criteria har saal ke prospectus mein thoda badal sakta hai).

**Aapko kya karna chahiye?**
*   **Official Website:** Sabse sahi aur latest jaankari ke liye **[www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org)** ki 'Admissions' section ko regular check karte rahein.
*   **Prospectus:** Jab admission notification aaye, toh uska "Prospectus" zarur padhein. Usmein "Eligibility Criteria" aur "Selection Process" ki poori jaankari di hoti hai.
*   **Previous Year Papers:** Entrance exam ki taiyari ke liye pichle saalon ke papers dekhein taaki aapko exam ka level samajh aa sake.

Main aapko salah dunga ki jab entrance form nikle, tab aap usse apply karein aur exam mein achhe se achhe marks laane ki koshish karein.

*Note: Main KGMU AI Chatbot hoon, jise Dr. Ayush Yadav dwara banaya gaya hai.*

entries.question: अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करना है डॉ. A Pradhan cardiology professor
entries.answer:
डॉ. अक्षय प्रधान (Dr. Akshaya Pradhan) कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग में प्रोफेसर हैं। केजीएमयू (KGMU) में किसी भी डॉक्टर से परामर्श के लिए **ऑनलाइन रजिस्ट्रेशन अनिवार्य है।**

आप नीचे दिए गए तरीकों में से किसी एक का उपयोग करके अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं:

1.  **वेबसाइट:** [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) पर जाएं। वहां 'New Appointment' चुनें, उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य और फिर KGMU अस्पताल का चयन करें।
2.  **फोन द्वारा:** आप 0522-2258880 या 0522-3539333 पर कॉल करके अपॉइंटमेंट के बारे में जानकारी प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।
3.  **SMS द्वारा:** "APPOINTMENT <नाम>" लिखकर 8887019134 पर SMS भेजें।

**महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी:**
*   **पर्ची का शुल्क:** ₹50 (फ्लैट रेट)।
*   **समय:** OPD का समय सोमवार से शुक्रवार सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक और शनिवार को सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक है।
*   **परामर्श:** यदि आप शहर से बाहर से आ रहे हैं, तो अपने संबंधित विभाग के लिए एक वैध रेफरल (Referral) पत्र साथ जरूर लाएं। 

मैं आपको सलाह दूंगा कि भीड़ से बचने के लिए पहले से ही ऑनलाइन अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर लें।

*नोट: मैं एक एआई सहायक हूँ और चिकित्सा निदान या उपचार के लिए योग्य नहीं हूँ। कृपया किसी भी स्वास्थ्य समस्या के लिए सीधे केजीएमयू ओपीडी (KGMU OPD) में डॉक्टर से मिलें। अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए इस चैट में कोई भी व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य विवरण, आधार नंबर या फोन नंबर साझा न करें।*
